1.w: The Lord reigns! The nations tremble. He sits enthroned above the cherubim; the earth shakes.

2.w: The Lord is elevated in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.

3.w: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is holy!

4.w: The king is strong; he loves justice. You ensure that legal decisions will be made fairly; you promote justice and equity in Jacob.

5.w: Praise the Lord our God. Worship before his footstool. He is holy!

6.w: Moses and Aaron were among his priests; Samuel was one of those who prayed to him. They prayed to the Lord and he answered them.

7.w: He spoke to them from a pillar of cloud; they obeyed his regulations and the ordinance he gave them.

8.w: O Lord our God, you answered them. They found you to be a forgiving God, but also one who punished their sinful deeds.

9.w: Praise the Lord our God! Worship on his holy hill, for the Lord our God is holy.
